summary: This Form 6-K filed by Frontier Nuclear & Minerals Inc. announces that its portfolio company Kadmos Energy is initiating an engineering validation program for its small modular reactor design. No transaction or special situation is involved. The press release describes technical milestones, regulatory strategy, and commercial targets for the SMR development. As a foreign private issuer report on routine business progress, this does not constitute an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change event. The filing is a standard operational update with no deal terms or corporate action requiring classification.
